2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART III—SEC. 4] # **INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** # **NOTIFICATION** Hyderabad, the 15th July, 2016 # **INSURANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE** **F. No. IRDAI/IAC/19/131/2016 .—** In exercise of the powers conferred by sub section (1) of Section 25 of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999 (41 of 1999), the Authority hereby makes the following notification: Chairman-cum-Managing Director, National Insurance Co. Ltd. is appointed as a member of the Insurance Advisory Committee by excluding Chairman-cum-Managing Director, United India Insurance Co. Ltd., who was one of the members of the Insurance Advisory Committee reconstituted vide Notification F. No. IRDA/IAC/7/97/2015 dated 25th May, 2015. T. S. VIJAYAN, Chairman [ADVT. III /4/Exty./181/161] Uploaded by Dte. of Printing at Government of India Press, Ring Road, Mayapuri, New Delhi-110064 and Published by the Controller of Publications, Delhi-110054.

**F. No. IRDAI/IAC/19/131/2016 .—** In exercise of the powers conferred by sub section (1) of Section 25 of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999 (41 of 1999),  the Authority hereby makes the following notification: 

Chairman-cum-Managing Director, National Insurance Co. Ltd. is appointed as a member of the Insurance Advisory Committee by excluding Chairman-cum-Managing Director, United India Insurance Co. Ltd., who was one of the members of the Insurance Advisory Committee reconstituted vide Notification F. No. IRDA/IAC/7/97/2015 dated 25<sup>th</sup> May, 2015. 

T. S. VIJAYAN, Chairman 

[ADVT. III /4/Exty./181/161]
